items.title: Before You Buy Paychex Stock, Settle This
items.summary: Paychex's largest business, Management Solutions, grew more slowly in the first quarter than management expected. That line brings in most of the company's revenue, so a lasting shortfall would slow all of Paychex (PAYX). Management says the shortfall is mostly revenue moving to another part of Paychex, but it has not said how much moved.

items.title: 2 Services Stocks to Own for Decades and 1 We Avoid
items.summary: Business services providers thrive by solving complex operational challenges for their clients, allowing them to focus on their secret sauce. These firms have helped their customers unlock huge efficiencies, so it’s no surprise the industry has posted a 21% gain over the past six months, beating the S&P 500 by 4.1 percentage points.
